d: A new AI-powered film and content production studio based in Dubai, specializing in AI-driven video and cinematic content.

Our client values ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work. The company fosters a culture of trust, providing team members with a high level of autonomy and freedom in decision-making rather than relying on micromanagement. At the same time, this autonomy comes with a strong sense of responsibility, the ability to make sound decisions, and readiness to take ownership of outcomes. Hands-on experience with AI tools and technologies is a mandatory requirement for this position.
q: Strong command of traditional audio and video post-production, with solid professional skills independent of AI tools.
Hands-on experience in video stitching, upscaling, image and audio cleanup, noise reduction, music bed creation, audio level adjustment, and sound mixing.
Understanding of quality standards and how decisions made at one production stage affect subsequent stages.
Genuine and strong interest in AI, with a willingness to experiment, test new models, and continuously expand their capabilities.
r: Video: Stitch video fragments, upscale resolution, fix visual imperfections, perform color correction and conforming, manage frame rates, and prepare assets in the required delivery formats.
Audio: Reduce noise and clean audio, create music beds, adjust audio levels, and mix sound according to the requirements of each platform.

Voice: Develop AI voiceover capabilities. Work with multiple parallel generation variations, experiment with emotional expression and speech prosody, maintain emotional consistency across individual clips, and ensure a unified tone and stable voice reference throughout all segments.
Test new voice and audio models in terms of speed, localization capabilities, and the naturalness of human speech. Monitor and ensure high-quality lip-sync.
Perform quality control (QC) before releasing any content.
